name: Beijing + Xi'an, China (ending in Hong Kong)
tagline: Great Wall, Terracotta Army, Hong Kong finale
whyParents: Walk a near-empty Great Wall, see the Forbidden City and Terracotta Army, then end with Hong Kong's harbour lights.
fly: ~19h, 1 stop (Seoul) out; 16h nonstop home from Hong Kong

costPP.flightsBasis: Estimate for open jaw: Korean Air JFK-ICN-PEK out Dec 12 + Cathay XIY-HKG Dec 18 and HKG-JFK nonstop Dec 19 (~$1,550 Main/standard economy), plus Beijing-Xi'an G-train 2nd class ~CNY 578 (~$80). Seen: Korean Air JFK-PEK RT from $1,020 to $1,328 for Dec 2026 dates; Cathay NYC-HKG RT from $1,053. Nonstop: Air China JFK-PEK runs 5x weekly (JFK 02:05, lands 06:40 next day), but no flight lands Dec 13 and a round trip needs the L visa; est ~$1,200 to $1,400 RT plus ~$140 to $250 visa costs.
costPP.lodgingBasis: 2 hotel rooms (Airbnb no longer lists mainland China stays for this; hotels handle required police registration): Beijing 3 nights x 2 x ~$125 (4-star, Wangfujing) + Xi'an 2 nights x 2 x ~$95 + Hong Kong 1 night x 2 x ~$230 = ~$1,590 / 4. Estimate; no Dec 2026 data seen.

flight.airline: Korean Air out, Cathay Pacific home
flight.routing: Out Sat Dec 12: KE82 JFK 13:00 to Seoul ICN 17:45 Sun, evening KE flight to Beijing PEK (lands ~9pm Dec 13). Home: CX947 Xi'an 15:50 to Hong Kong 19:05 Fri Dec 18; CX840 HKG 16:30 to JFK ~7:30pm Sat Dec 19.
flight.notes: Open jaw ending in Hong Kong is what makes the trip visa-free. Cathay is oneworld (earn AA miles) and a Capital One transfer partner. Cheaper visa-free alternative: Korean Air both ways, home Xi'an-Seoul-JFK (Korea also counts as a third country). Air China nonstop JFK-PEK (5x weekly, 747-8) would land Mon Dec 14.

weather.precip: Dry, sunny, windy; snow rare. Xi'an ~42F/27F, Hong Kong ~68F/59F

stay: Beijing Wangfujing (walk to Forbidden City), Xi'an inside city wall, Hong Kong Tsim Sha Tsui (harbour views)
getAround: Metro and DiDi rides in cities; private driver to Mutianyu (~1.5h each way); G-train Beijing West to Xi'an North ~4h10m to 5h.
entry: Visa-free 240-hour transit: enter from US/Korea, exit to Hong Kong, onward ticket required. Round trip needs L visa ($140).
events: Low season: no Chinese holidays Dec 13 to 19, thin crowds at the Wall
Hong Kong Symphony of Lights harbour show nightly at 8pm
Forbidden City closed Mondays (Dec 14); tickets release 7 days ahead, passport required
pros: Great Wall nearly empty in winter
Terracotta Army plus a 200 mph bullet train
No visa needed with the Hong Kong exit
cons: Visa ($140 + center fee) unless exiting via Hong Kong
Google blocked; set up Alipay and roaming eSIM first

itinerary.title: Arrive Beijing (Sun Dec 13)
itinerary.plan: Land via Seoul ~9pm, taxi or driver to Wangfujing hotel (~45 min). Sleep.
itinerary.eat: Late snack at the hotel or a Wangfujing noodle shop

itinerary.title: Great Wall at Mutianyu
itinerary.plan: Private driver early. Cable car up, walk restored towers, toboggan down if open (riders 60+ may be refused).

itinerary.title: Forbidden City + Jingshan
itinerary.plan: Forbidden City (book 7 days ahead, bring passports), climb Jingshan Park for the view, hutong walk.

itinerary.title: Temple of Heaven, train to Xi'an
itinerary.plan: Early Temple of Heaven with locals doing tai chi, then G-train to Xi'an (~4.5h). Evening Muslim Quarter.
itinerary.eat: Roujiamo and biangbiang noodles, Muslim Quarter

photo.author: Maros Mraz (edit: Thegreenj)
photo.caption: Hall of Prayer, Temple of Heaven

itinerary.title: Terracotta Army
itinerary.plan: Driver or guide to the Terracotta Warriors (~1h). Pits 1 to 3 plus museum, back for evening.
itinerary.eat: Dumpling banquet at De Fa Chang

itinerary.title: City Wall bikes, fly to Hong Kong
itinerary.plan: Bike the Xi'an City Wall in the morning, 3:50pm flight to Hong Kong, evening harbour stroll.
itinerary.eat: Cantonese dinner in Tsim Sha Tsui

itinerary.title: Hong Kong morning, fly home
itinerary.plan: Star Ferry and Peak Tram views, airport by 1:30pm, 4:30pm nonstop lands JFK same evening.
itinerary.eat: Dim sum at Tim Ho Wan

photo.author: Benh LIEU SONG
photo.caption: Hong Kong harbour from the Peak
